```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(summarytools)
library(gmodels)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
lbw_data <- read_excel('data/Low birth weight.xlsx') %>% 
    rename(mother_weight = lwt,
           preterm_labor = ptl,
           hypertension = ht,
           uterine_irritability = ui,
           first_trimester_vist = ftv,
           birth_weight = bwt) %>% 
    mutate(smoke_yn = if_else(smoke == 1, 'Yes', 'No'),
           hypertension_yn = factor(hypertension, 
                                    labels = c('No', 'Yes'))
           )

lbw_data
```

## Simple Frequency Tables

### Individual Frequency Tables

```{r}


lbw_data %>% 
    group_by(smoke_yn) %>% 
    summarise(count = n()) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    summarise(smoke_yn, 
              count,
              proportion = round(count/sum(count), 2),
              percentage = proportion * 100) %>% 
    mutate(percentage_w_n = glue::glue('{count} ({percentage}%)' )) %>% 
    select(smoke_yn, percentage_w_n)
```

```{r}
lbw_data %>% 
    group_by(hypertension_yn) %>% 
    summarise(count = n()) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    summarise(hypertension_yn, 
              count,
              proportion = round(count/sum(count), 2),
              percentage = proportion * 100) %>% 
    mutate(percentage_w_n = glue::glue('{count} ({percentage}%)')) %>%
    select(hypertension_yn, percentage_w_n)
```

```{r}
CrossTable(lbw_data$smoke_yn, lbw_data$hypertension_yn, chisq = TRUE)
```

```{r}
CrossTable(lbw_data$smoke_yn, lbw_data$low, chisq = TRUE)
```

### Comprehensive Frequency Tables

```{r}
freq <- freq(lbw_data)
```

## T.Test

```{r}
t.test(lbw_data$birth_weight ~ lbw_data$smoke_yn, 
       var.equal = TRUE, 
       alternative = "two.sided")
```

```{r}
lbw_data %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = smoke_yn, 
               y = birth_weight, 
               fill = smoke_yn)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_minimal()
```

## Logistic Regression

```{r}

glm(low ~ smoke, family = binomial(logit), data = lbw_data)
```

```{r}
low_smoke_hyp <- glm(low ~ smoke + hypertension, family = binomial(logit), data = lbw_data)

summary(low_smoke_hyp)
```

```{r}
exp(cbind(OR = coef(low_smoke_hyp), confint(low_smoke_hyp)))
```
